SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'WHAN') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, RD_DATE, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, UNIT_MEASURE, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_AMT, PO_CREATE_DATE, PURCHASER_ID, PURCHASER_NAME, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, PLANT, REMARK, ADD_USER_ID, KEY_1 AS MODEL_NO, KEY_2 AS MAKER_NAME FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
